# lumos_entitlement (Resource)

Entitlement Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lumos_entitlement" "my_entitlement" {
  app_id = "...my_app_id..."
  label  = "...my_label..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The ID of the app that will own this entitlement. Requires replacement if changed.
- `label` (String) Human-readable label for the entitlement.

### Read-Only

- `approval_workflow_override` (Attributes) The entitlement's approval workflow override. Returns {id} by default; expand with expand=approval_workflow_override for the full workflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--approval_workflow_override))
- `appstore_settings` (Attributes) The entitlement's App Store-catalog settings. Null unless expanded with expand=appstore_settings. Omitted entirely (not present, not null) when the parent app isn't enrolled in the App Store. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--appstore_settings))
- `custom_approval_message_override` (String) This entitlement's own custom approval message, shown to requesters when the entitlement is approved, overriding the app's. Null means this entitlement inherits the app's approval message.
- `deprovisioning_workflow` (Attributes) The entitlement's deprovisioning workflow. Returns {id} by default; expand with expand=deprovisioning_workflow for the full workflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deprovisioning_workflow))
- `description` (String) Optional long-form description of the entitlement.
- `entitlement_type_label` (String) Human-readable label for the entitlement's type (e.g. 'Role', 'License', 'Group').
- `id` (String) The ID of this entitlement.
- `provisioning_workflow` (Attributes) The entitlement's provisioning workflow. Returns {id} by default; expand with expand=provisioning_workflow for the full workflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provisioning_workflow))
- `source` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--appstore_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `appstore_settings`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_requester_groups_override` (Attributes List) Groups whose members may request this entitlement, overriding the app's allowed requester groups. Null means this entitlement inherits the app's allowed requester groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--appstore_settings--allowed_requester_groups_override))
- `request_validation_webhook` (Attributes) The inline webhook called to validate access requests for this entitlement. This is configured directly on the entitlement; null means no webhook is configured (there is no inheritance from the app). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--appstore_settings--request_validation_webhook))
- `time_based_access_override` (Attributes) This entitlement's own time-based access options. Null means this entitlement inherits the app's time-based access options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--appstore_settings--time_based_access_override))
- `visible_in_appstore` (Boolean) Whether this entitlement is visible in the App Store catalog.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = lumos_entitlement.my_lumos_entitlement
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import lumos_entitlement.my_lumos_entitlement "..."
```
